title: Alignment Conveyor
body:
Teleports any objects that touch it into the center of the conveyor.


The Alignment Conveyor is a structure that can be purchased from Alan's AutoLogistics. It centers objects that pass through it.

Functionality

The Alignment Conveyor appears as, and is otherwise functionally identical to, a standard Straight Conveyor. However, whenever an object touches the bounding box of the conveyor belt at any point along its length, it instantly teleports the object directly to the end of the belt (unlike what the description of the structure says) and centers it. This will also force objects to stand upright unless they exceed a vertical height limit, where they will then be laid horizontally.

When a vehicle or trailer is over the conveyor belt and a player exits the vehicle it causes an update on the items inside allowing them to be teleported. This means you can unload your trailer by driving on top and exiting, however they will all try to teleport at once.

Trivia

  • Prior to update 1.52.1, the price of the alignment conveyor was $280
  • Items that have been teleported using alignment conveyors seem to be unable to teleport again more testing needs to be done however you can get around this by using a drawer and some logic
  • Items cannot be teleported more than once by the same alignment conveyor until another item has been teleported by said conveyor, allowing the first item to be teleported again.
